summary: ACCEPT. Independent review found AD-24/R-25 internally consistent, feasible, source-grounded, and bounded after two correction rounds. Requests one through nine retain streamed disabled-thinking generic required selection; request ten alone uses exact named submit_code_logic selection while retaining both strict declarations. Existing complete-turn preflight and local validation remain the safety authority, including when a provider ignores the named choice. The source-free gate now proves both exact request shapes before fresh source-bearing qualification. No prompt injection, manual provider loop, SDK fork, dependency, schema or migration, endpoint, model, credential, source expansion, host or system change, or Story 12.4/12.5 behavior is introduced. Tasks may be generated and independently definition-reviewed under the user's standing continuation authority.
